en.hubeali: Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, raising it,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Oiling the two eyebrows removes the headache’.
en.sarwar: 9. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Ali ibn Asbat in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Applying viola oil to one’s eyebrows dispels headaches.’”
